description: Verify a root AuthorityDelegationV1 issued by this server's key, with the SDK chain verifier: shape, delegation_id, signature, time window and revocation status from this process's in-memory revocation store. Returns the verifier's state (valid, invalid, indeterminate or unsupported) and its failure codes, for example REVOKED or EXPIRED. A delegation this server did not issue, including one signed by this key under another issuer name, resolves no key and is not valid here. A delegation issued before a restart has revocation status unknown, because the store is in memory.

delegation.description: The AuthorityDelegationV1 to check, as a JSON string or object.

name: check_authority_delegation
title: Check Authority Delegation
